connector.name: Golf Coach
connector.registryDescription: A stats-driven golf coach: Trackman + on-course rounds, turned into a practice plan.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package golf-coach. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bjornj12 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRACKMAN_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer access token captured from an authenticated Trackman portal session. Optional if you have run `golf-coach login` (the server then loads the cached token automatically).
